cert_project_submission_dates_order.name: cert_project_submission_dates_order
cert_project_submission_dates_order.value: "cert_project"."submitted_at" IS NULL OR "cert_project"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "cert_project"."accepted_at" >= "cert_project"."submitted_at"

conversation_goal_requires_project.name: conversation_goal_requires_project
conversation_goal_requires_project.value: "conversation"."goal_id" IS NULL OR "conversation"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

document_void_reason_consistent.name: document_void_reason_consistent
document_void_reason_consistent.value: (NOT "document"."voided" AND "document"."void_reason" IS NULL) OR ("document"."voided" AND "document"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("document"."void_reason")) > 0)

entity_role_validity_order.name: entity_role_validity_order
entity_role_validity_order.value: "entity_role"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "entity_role"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "entity_role"."valid_until" >= "entity_role"."valid_from"

role_binding_scope_consistent.name: role_binding_scope_consistent
role_binding_scope_consistent.value: ("role_binding"."scope_type" = 'project' AND "role_binding"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("role_binding"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'own') AND "role_binding"."scope_id" IS NULL)

run_goal_requires_project.name: run_goal_requires_project
run_goal_requires_project.value: "run"."goal_id" IS NULL OR "run"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

undo_record_state_consistent.name: undo_record_state_consistent
undo_record_state_consistent.value: ("undo_record"."status" = 'pending' AND "undo_record"."after_version" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_version" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_at" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_by" IS NULL) OR ("undo_record"."status" = 'available' AND "undo_record"."after_version" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_version" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_at" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_by" IS NULL) OR ("undo_record"."status" = 'undone' AND "undo_record"."after_version" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_version" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_at" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_by" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_draft_file_tombstone.name: workspace_draft_file_tombstone
workspace_draft_file_tombstone.value: ("workspace_draft_file"."is_deleted" AND "workspace_draft_file"."sha256" IS NULL AND "workspace_draft_file"."byte_size" IS NULL) OR (NOT "workspace_draft_file"."is_deleted" AND "workspace_draft_file"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_draft_file"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL)
